title: Bois & raquettes de tennis de table
subtitle: annonces vérifiées sur photo (revêtements, sacs et vêtements écartés)
description: table tennis blades (bare wood) and rackets (blade + rubber)

primary.name: bois
primary.def: a table-tennis blade/wood base without rubber attached (bois, blade, Schlägerholz, madeira sem borracha)

secondary.name: raquette
secondary.def: a finished racket with rubber attached (raquette, schläger, table tennis racket, pala con goma, set containing a racket)

auxiliary.name: gomme
auxiliary.def: table-tennis rubber/sheet (revêtement/gomme) without a blade, or rubber+blade combo listed as rubber

vars.other_note: anything else: rubber only, balls, apparel, tables, nets, bags, unrelated items
vars.disambig: rubber visible = raquette, bare wood = bois
